Name: Ash's Sauna and Farmhouse Redesign
Author: Tortart
Description:
[size=3]I found it weird how the farmhouse didn't have a kitchen or somewhere for Grandpa to clean himself so I decided to make both those things possible. I also thought a sauna in the starter farmhouse would be a great way of getting energy (especially early game) without needing to travel all the way to the bathhouse

Now adds:

[list]
[*][size=3]Functional sauna area, with upper area, that expands with every upgrade (minus the cellar upgrade)[/size]
[*][size=3]Functional kitchen in the starter farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=3]Spouses can go to the second floor of the second house upgrade via a hidden path built for them by the stairs. NOTE: They can't go into the sauna area (sorry about that)[/size]
[*][size=3]Fun little southern room replacement where it now becomes a functional greenhouse area[/size]
[/list][/size]


[color=#f6b26b][u][size=6]Compatibility[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/u][/color][size=3][color=#93c47d]Farmhouse renovations[/color]- Yep! They should all be there :)
[color=#ffd966]Farmhouse cutscenes[/color]- There might be a few bugs for mods that add cutscenes to the farmhouse. You MAY need Noclip Mod for that
[color=#ffd966]Furniture[/color]- Like the cutscenes, you may need Noclip Mod because furniture may go out of bounds, into the void, when you upgrade the farmhouse
[color=#93c47d]Multiple Spouses[/color]- Yep! I didn't move the spouse room so it should be compatible with mods that allow multiple spouses
[color=#dd7e6b]Cabins[/color]- Nope. No compatibility with cabins. I made this for the main farmhouse alone
